name: br-millet-choice
description: BR Millet Choice storefront and order-management application

scripts.build: node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('public', 'dist', { recursive: true }); console.log('Build completed: static assets prepared in dist.');"
scripts.check: node --check server/index.js && node --check server/app.js && node --check server/promote-admin.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check api/index.js
